messages:
SRE-Bot: SLO alert: hosted-inference-gateway 5xx rate > 4% for 10m (SLO burn). Rolling window shows spike starting ~1951032000. Notified #eng-sre and #support :rotating_light:
Alex Nguyen: seeing it. dashboard spike on frontend gateway, mostly 504 + some 502s.
Maria Patel: any recent deploys?
Jen Ortiz: not on gateway, last gateway deploy was 2h ago. Model-serving teams did a canary 30m ago though.
Phil K.: adding traces, but sampling looks sparse. I think probe requests are OK but real traffic failing.
Alex Nguyen: short repro — curl to /v1/generate times out after TLS handshake sometimes. Example: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> hangs then 504.
Maria Patel: running log query now. Splunk: `index=prod gateway "status=504" | stats count by upstream_host, route` -> most 504s point to upstream `model-pool-quant` and `model-pool-legacy`
Jen Ortiz: checking k8s pods for model-pool-quant: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-pool-quant` -> some pods are in CrashLoopBackOff?
Phil K.: I see `OOMKilled` on one of the quant pods around 1951032100 in kube events. Could explain backpressure to gateway.
Support-Bot: multiple support tickets opened: #TICK-3145 (large batch customer reporting timeouts), #TICK-3146 (integration tests failing).
Alex Nguyen: can we confirm circuit-breakers? Gateway logs show `upstream response body truncated` and `connection reset by peer`.
Maria Patel: extracting a small logs snippet:
```
[1951032112] gateway error: dial tcp 10.42.3.12:8080: connect: connection refused
[1951032113] proxy: upstream returned 504 after 30001ms
[1951032120] gateway: rsp len 0, closing
```

Jen Ortiz: that IP is model-pool-quant-3. I'm tailing its logs.
Phil K.: while Jen tails, I'm rolling one extra replica for quant pool to absorb requests: `kubectl scale deployment model-pool-quant --replicas=6 -n inference`
Jen Ortiz: model-pool-quant-3 logs show repeated `KV cache eviction` and then `CUBLAS allocation failed` followed by `panic: runtime error`. Looks like memory fragmentation after spike.
Alex Nguyen: ramped scaling should reduce 5xx if it's capacity. We should also route traffic away from quant pool as emergency fallback.
Maria Patel: updating routing rule: set `fallback_model_variant=legacy-quant` for route `/v1/generate` via console. Making change now.
SRE-Bot: routing change applied, will take ~30s to propagate.
Support-Bot: customer replies: "timeouts are intermittent but noticed after 09:05 UTC" — matches timestamps.
Phil K.: after scaling and routing change, 5xx rate dropped from 5.2% -> 0.9% in 4 minutes. Dashboard shows latency stable.
Jen Ortiz: creating a short-lived mitigation PR to add a memory headroom check in model-pool autoscaler and an alert when pod OOM rate > 1/min. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/789
Alex Nguyen: note: tracing gap for some failing requests — sample traces for the 504s show gateway -> model-pool with no downstream spans (server closed before application span created).
Maria Patel: hypothesis: backend process crashes during early init on heavy requests. Will ask model-serving to revert the canary and investigate recent quant library bump.
Phil K.: opening incident postmortem stub: we had capacity shortage + a pod memory regression in model-pool-quant after a canary bump. Mitigations: scale, route fallback, increased OOM alert, revert canary.
Jen Ortiz: reproduction steps added to ticket: 1) run high qps synthetic load hitting quant variant 2) monitor pod memory and logs for `CUBLAS allocation failed` 3) observe gateway 504s.
Support-Bot: flagged customer tickets as "mitigated" and sent status update.
Alex Nguyen: follow-ups: (1) immediate: revert quant library canary, (2) medium: add pre-check in canary rollout to run mem-intensive smoke test in a staging pool, (3) long-term: enhance tracing sampling for error paths so we don't have trace gaps.
Maria Patel: I will coordinate canary revert with model-serving. Assigning to @Jen and @Phil for the autoscaler alert and SLO postmortem writeup.
Phil K.: will draft postmortem and notify PS for impacted customers.
SRE-Bot: incident resolved: 5xx rate under threshold. Creating archived incident for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Alex Nguyen: thanks team. tagging for retro. :coffee:
